implemented: Shared Python provenance follows comprehension assignment-expression binding and reuses the existing own-function yield traversal.
SARJ011 populates scope-role facts lazily instead of eagerly rebuilding cached values.
TypeScript SQL value checks inspect padded quoted interpolation; shared SQL extraction follows literal join delimiters and preserves executed substitutions.
SQL111 supports omitted referenced primary-key columns and preserves non-enforced constraints; SQL112 reuses relation/index analysis with bounded predicate and executable-body compatibility.
Config comment checks reuse validated literal masks instead of reparsing/scanning them.

sql.interpretation: The inspected deltas are isolated controls; no new live defect or production-incident prevention is claimed.

policy: No blanket severity promotion, new dependency or automatic source rewrite.
Raw diagnostic multiplicity, source encodings, private corpus boundaries and managed consumer approvals are preserved.
Native package fixes and exact bundle pins are released together.
limitations: Fifty investigations are not fifty defects or fifty implemented rules.
Finite controls and diagnostic parity do not establish universal correctness or zero total baseline false positives.
TypeScript corpus contains existing trusted-fragment false-positive/uncertain findings; none was newly introduced in the inspected panel.
Timing figures describe this host and panel, not a fleet or whole-linter speedup.
Unknown partial-index predicates, Unicode SQL escape identifiers, broader callback header/class scope and other deferred boundaries remain explicit.
